TD03 preserves public planeswalker and battle-protector domain, excludes own protected entities and accepts shroud/hexproof without BecomesTarget or TargetsChosen events. TD04 verifies the neighboring seat in both attack modes; TD14 verifies active teammate ownership, opposing team domain, and bypass of declaration-only defender restriction.

TD05 proves nonactive recipients do not attack and preserves the full fanout/collection/event union. TD06 and TD07 prove exactly-once multiplied counts for plain and target-copy creation, four explicit defender slots, and downstream collection use.
TD08 checks noncreature copies do not attack or ask for a defender. TD09 exercises wrong actor, own defender, missing/extra slots and multiple entities per slot with exact unchanged pending state.
